title: Pagination maxPages bug
body: If you set the `maxPages` parameter of the pagination widget to 5, you start getting negative pages when you click on 5

comments.body: What do you mean by "padding of the pagination"?
The padding being the max number of pages to the right and the left of the current one.
Ah ok, I see that this option may actually be more useful than the `maxPages` (because we could guess the max pages by reading the helper configuration)
Padding is cool, maxpages is to limit the number of pages even if there are more results
Actually padding is already available as an option @Jerskouille: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js#pagination
You can safely rely on the readme for all things documentation on widgets, we keep it updated.
Oh you're right, I relied on the `example/app.js` more than on the README, my bad.
